name: Server Technology PDU
description: Reads a Server Technology PDU over its JAWS API: which socket feeds which device, how much each draws, and what the rack sensors say. Nothing here switches an outlet.

config.label: PDU address
config.hint: Where the PDU answers, for example https://pdu-r14-a.dc2.example.com. The management address on your own network.

config.label: API user
config.hint: A read-only user on the PDU. The password is written separately, on the Adapters screen, and is never stored here.

config.label: Which feed this PDU is
config.hint: A rack normally has two PDUs, one per feed. Saying which this one is turns "forty things are on this PDU" into "this device is on A only", which is the question a power diagram is for.

config.label: Verify the certificate
config.hint: Turn this off only for a PDU using its own self-signed certificate on a management network you control.

config.label: Timeout (seconds)
config.hint: A PDU is a small computer on a slow network. Ten seconds is generous and still short enough that a sweep of forty racks finishes.
